message.content: {"caption":"A timeline shows an agent’s strategies developing from simple navigation actions into more adaptive and generalized reasoning.","description":"A horizontal test-time learning timeline presents four stages along a curved, connected path. It begins with a procedural/execution strategy, illustrated by clicking navigation links; progresses to atomic self-reflection, such as re-checking an identifier; then to an evolved adaptive check that uses available search or filter options to ensure completeness; and ends with a generalized complex/effective strategy that cross-references task requirements, prevents errors, and reassesses available options. Small icons mark the stages, and an arrow indicates progression to the right.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
